verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser runs AI browser agents (HyperAgent and hosted agents), so letting users plug in external MCP servers as tools is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence only documents Hyperbrowser's own MCP server, which exposes its scraping and crawling to other AI clients. That is the server role and does not count here. Nothing shows Hyperbrowser or HyperAgent connecting to user-supplied MCP servers.
